title: LEGO vehicle wheel assembly
completion: All six wheels are attached to the vehicle.

steps.instruction: Place one dark grey rim inside one black tire.

rule.question: Is the dark grey LEGO wheel hub pressed inside the black rubber tire, forming one wheel?

steps.instruction: Press the tire-and-rim unit onto each wheel axle of the vehicle (repeat 5x).

rule.question: Is a black LEGO wheel mounted on the yellow axle pin on the side of the LEGO car?
